purpose: A full-width framed panel that presents a product scene (a console mock or a diagram) under a section title, on a texture, with optional tabs that each play one beat of the scene. The scene is a slot: the page passes a `ConsoleMockup` or a diagram and reads the selected tab from the slot scope. In `console` variant the scene keeps a 1.9:1 aspect and can be cropped and faded at the bottom. From the design sample's site `ConsoleShowcaseSection`.
useWhen: Use ConsoleShowcaseSection for a marketing band that plays a product scene under a section title.
Showing the product itself on a landing page.
A tour of three or four views of one screen.
avoidWhen: For a screenshot with copy beside it — use `MediaSplitSection`.
For code — use `FeatureScrollSection` (a step with `code`) or `CliTerminalSection`.
bestPractices: Two to four tabs, each a different view, labelled with one word.
Crop the scene only to remove empty space at its bottom (0.1–0.3).
